idea-plugin.name: Workbench for Minecraft
idea-plugin.description:
Review Minecraft modpack changes and run local development checks from IntelliJ.

Workbench explains what changed, shows the files involved, and asks before running anything that can modify your project.

  • Review one GitHub pull request's Supersymmetry recipe changes without switching branches.
  • See project checks and suggested next actions in Workbench Home.
  • Inspect retained file changes in IntelliJ's native diff viewer.
  • Run the core-owned setup wizard in a visible console.

Requires the Workbench CLI and one local IntelliJ project.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Added first-run CLI and setup readiness checks.
  • Added native wheelhouse installation guidance and an explicit setup/repair entry point.
  • Added a native PR Recipe Review flow with exact provider planning, consent, findings, files, and attention.
  • Rewrote Marketplace information in plain English.
